description: Bottom-sheet confirmation for the destructive delete, echoing the record being removed. Replaces the blocking Alert.alert; uses the shared confirm/form-sheet recipe.

merchantName.description: Transaction name echoed in the body

body.template: This removes "{merchantName} {amountLabel}" and can't be undone.

behavior: On confirm: run delete → successHaptic() → router.back(). On failure: close sheet, surface InlineErrorCard above the CTA. The solid colors.error fill is the one sanctioned solid semantic fill (destructive intent).

accessibility.colorIndependent: trash context + the word 'Delete' pair with the red fill; reduced-motion swaps slide-in for instant present
